newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Former Ethiopian deputy premier to be charged.
newsitem.headline: Former Ethiopian deputy premier to be charged.

text.p: Former Ethiopian deputy prime minister and minister of defence Tamirat Layne will appear in court next week charged with abuse of power, state television said late on Tuesday.
It quoted a spokesman for the justice ministry as saying Tamirat would be tried along with eight alleged accomplices -- seven businessmen and a government official. It gave no names.
Tamirat, who was second-in-command in the government of Prime Minister Meles Zenawi, was accused of "falling prey to the corrupting comfort of city life" and sacked by parliament in October.
